registration.sourceProfile: Frozen v11 stock-equivalent, not current v12. Exactly the admitted void observation seam; mixture and new live bounds disabled.
registration.purpose: Collect unchanged native actual-choice and existing candidate/legality records. No extra candidate/action/rollout/model or policy. Combat outcomes only verify original controls.
registration.familyFolds: SHA256(a19-v11-legal-catalog-family-v1/<raw-family-seed>), first BE uint32 modulo10:0..5train,6..7validation,8..9test; whole families kept together before new labels.
registration.foldIsolation: Separate gzip label files. Integrity verification may inspect all labels; no heldout class/performance summary or model/threshold/feature selection. Previous opened805-label v10 test stays closed.
registration.preflight: Fourteen fixed admitted rich-recorder controls on both hosts. Require exact label and lightweight mutable-frame digests versus full-recorder goldens, original input/fulltrace/outcome/turns, logical counters and both package module identities before collection.
registration.cold: Fixed36 cases already chosen by parent v11 before strength opening. Both hosts replay them once after6048 complete originals; every fulltrace, actual-turn projection, label/light-frame hash and logical counter must match main.
gates: All6148 expected executions and original input/full action-event trace/outcome/turn/quality counters exact; zero engine/model/timing failures.
All28 cross-host preflight label and light-frame hashes equal admitted full-state-recorder goldens.
Independent Bun and Python original-control, raw producer/subobject byte SHA, public wait legality, family/fold and applicable cold checks.
All6048 cases retained, including zero-eligible cases. No outside-catalog or partial projected-command observations dropped; partial score semantics retained.
All72 cold controls exact versus main labels, target memory, reference tokens, RNG/UUID prefixes and array identity. No full snapshot hashes claimed for the lighter main logger.
registration.termination: One attempt per assigned case. No automatic retry, reassignment, deadline extension, source/case/gate tuning or favorable subset rescue. Preserve all failure output.
registration.futureGate: Any future predictor stays inactive pending fresh current-v12 legal authoritative draft/setup/memory parity, independent strength and overall-average+10% complete fight/decision cost.

zeroGamePackageFailure.failure: Eight sealed historical documentation log files absent from remote parent source capsule. Transfer their original registered bytes; no source/seed/gate/deadline change.

"""Allocate only replays from the closed v11 bank; fix data folds before observing new labels."""
from pathlib import Path
import collections,gzip,hashlib,json
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;old=p.parent/'barrel-forecast-mixture-v11-confirmation-20261117'
assert not(p/'registration.json').exists()
source=(old/'strength-registration.json').read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest()=='1a31dd5fbba8544bf25ad96c3d10ab47165f4ddeabaf8602d9096f83c1dbb3ff'
cases=json.loads((old/'cases.json').read_text());assert len(cases)==6048
index={(r['board'],r['game']):r['arms']['stock']for r in json.loads(gzip.decompress((old/'complete-trace-index.json.gz').read_bytes()))}
assert len(index)==6048
references={};raw_files=[]
for host in ['local','puffalo']:
 for f in sorted((old/('confirmation-'+host)).glob('*.jsonl.gz')):
  raw_files.append({'path':str(f.relative_to(old)),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
  for line in gzip.open(f,'rt'):
   r=json.loads(line)
   if r['mode']!='stock':continue
   key=(r['board'],r['game']);assert key not in references
   expected=index[key]
   for field in ['inputSha256','traceSha256','score','winner']:assert r[field]==expected[field]
   references[key]={**expected,'actualTurns':len(r['actualTurns']),'searchUses':r['quality']['searchUses'],
    'neural':r['quality']['neural'],'logicalWork':[{k:v for k,v in w.items()if k!='msTotal'}for w in r['quality']['work']]}
assert set(references)==set(index)
families=collections.defaultdict(list)
for c in cases:families[c['board']].append(c)
assert len(families)==1512 and all(len(cs)==4 for cs in families.values())
old_jobs=json.loads((p.parent/'barrel-forecast-model-mixture-20261117/v10-functional/barrel-teacher-cases.json').read_text())
old_seeds={j['seed']for j in old_jobs};assert not old_seeds&{c['seed']for c in cases}
styles=collections.defaultdict(list)
for board,group in sorted(families.items()):
 assert len({c['seed']for c in group})==1 and len({c['opponentStyle']for c in group})==1
 styles[group[0]['opponentStyle']].append(board)
assert len(styles)==4 and all(len(boards)==378 for boards in styles.values())
assignments={}
for style,boards in styles.items():
 for ordinal,board in enumerate(boards):assignments[board]='local'if ordinal//27<12 else'puffalo'
splits={};folds={};host_cells=collections.Counter();jobs=[]
for ordinal,c in enumerate(cases):
 board=c['board'];family_id=f'v11-confirmation-20261117-{board}';host=assignments[board]
 code=int.from_bytes(hashlib.sha256(f'a19-v11-legal-catalog-family-v1/{c["seed"]}'.encode()).digest()[:4],'big')%10
 fold='train'if code<6 else'validation'if code<8 else'test'
 if board in folds:assert folds[board]==fold
 folds[board]=fold
 ref=references[(board,c['game'])];assert c['expectedInputSha256']==ref['inputSha256']
 job={**c,'caseId':f'v11c-{board}-{c["game"]}','familyId':family_id,'fold':fold,'assignedHost':host,'ordinal':ordinal,'reference':ref}
 jobs.append(job);splits.setdefault(host,[]).append(job)
 host_cells[(host,c['opponentStyle'],c['map'],c['ownDoctrine'],c['opponentDoctrine'])]+=1
assert len(splits['local'])==5184 and len(splits['puffalo'])==864
assert len(host_cells)==216
assert all(n==(48 if k[0]=='local'else 8)for k,n in host_cells.items())
for host in ['local','puffalo']:(p/f'cases-{host}.json').write_text(json.dumps(splits[host],separators=(',',':'))+'\n')
(p/'cases-all.json').write_text(json.dumps(jobs,separators=(',',':'))+'\n')
lookup={(j['board'],j['game']):j for j in jobs}
cold=[]
for case in json.loads((old/'fresh-cold-cases.json').read_text()):
 job=lookup[(case['board'],case['game'])];cold.append(job)
assert len(cold)==36 and len({(j['board'],j['game'])for j in cold})==36
(p/'cold-cases.json').write_text(json.dumps(cold,separators=(',',':'))+'\n')
ledger={'sourceRegistrationSha256':hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest(),'caseFileSha256':hashlib.sha256((old/'cases.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 'originalTraceIndexSha256':hashlib.sha256((old/'complete-trace-index.json.gz').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'originalControlFiles':raw_files,
 'families':1512,'cases':6048,'hostCases':{k:len(v)for k,v in splits.items()},
 'familyFoldCounts':dict(collections.Counter(folds.values())),'caseFoldCounts':dict(collections.Counter(j['fold']for j in jobs)),
 'familyHostAndFolds':[{'board':b,'familyId':f'v11-confirmation-20261117-{b}','host':assignments[b],'fold':folds[b]}for b in sorted(families)],
 'eachHostHasAll108StyleMapOwnOpponentDoctrineCells':True,'allFourCasesStayWithFamily':True,
 'allRawFamilySeedsAvoidPreviousV10Teacher':True,'noNewSeedsOrIndependentStrengthSamples':True,
 'heldoutLabelsNotYetCollected':True,'fitterNotChosenOrStarted':True}
(p/'data-allocation.json').write_text(json.dumps(ledger,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in ledger.items()if k not in ['originalControlFiles','familyHostAndFolds']}))

"""Independent raw-byte integrity, legality, family and cross-host checks; no held-out model metrics."""
from pathlib import Path
import gzip,hashlib,json,sys
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;phase=sys.argv[1];assert phase in ['preflight','complete']
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
regraw=(p/'registration.json').read_bytes();reg=json.loads(regraw);seal=sha(regraw)
for f in reg['files']:assert sha((p/f['path']).read_bytes())==f['sha256'],f['path']
def load(f):return json.loads((p/f).read_text())
def members(raw):
 # Preserve original JavaScript number notation when checking producer subobject hashes.
 text=raw.decode('utf-8');dec=json.JSONDecoder();i=1;out={}
 assert text[0]=='{'
 while True:
  while text[i].isspace():i+=1
  if text[i]=='}':break
  key,end=dec.raw_decode(text,i);i=end
  while text[i].isspace():i+=1
  assert text[i]==':';i+=1
  while text[i].isspace():i+=1
  start=i;_,i=dec.raw_decode(text,i);out[key]=text[start:i].encode('utf-8')
  while text[i].isspace():i+=1
  if text[i]==',':i+=1
  else:assert text[i]=='}';break
 return out
original=load('cases-all.json');preflight=load('preflight-cases.json');cold=load('cold-cases.json')
assert len(original)==6048 and len({j['caseId']for j in original})==6048
records={};inventory=[];total=0;families={};frames=0
for stage in (['preflight']if phase=='preflight'else['preflight','collection','cold']):
 for host in ['local','puffalo']:
  root=p/f'{stage}-{host}';status=load(f'{stage}-{host}/status.json')
  jobs=preflight if stage=='preflight'else cold if stage=='cold'else[j for j in original if j['assignedHost']==host]
  expected={j['caseId']:j for j in jobs};controls={};payloads=set();observations=0
  assert status['complete']and not status['errors']and not status['liveWorkerPids']and status['registrationSha256']==seal and status['fights']==len(jobs)
  files=sorted(root.glob('*.jsonl.gz'))
  for f in files:inventory.append({'path':str(f.relative_to(p)),'bytes':f.stat().st_size,'sha256':sha(f.read_bytes())})
  for f in files:
   if '-labels.'in f.name:continue
   for line in gzip.open(f,'rb'):
    r=json.loads(line);j=expected[r['caseId']];assert r['caseId']not in controls;controls[r['caseId']]=r
    assert r['registrationSha256']==seal and r['stage']==stage and r['host']==host and r['mode']=='observe'and r['fold']==j['fold']and r['familyId']==j['familyId']
    assert r['jobId']==stage+'/'+r['caseId']
    for key in ['inputSha256','traceSha256','score','winner','actualTurns','actualTurnsSha256']:
     if key in j['reference']:assert r[key]==j['reference'][key]
    parts=members(line);assert sha(parts['frames'])==r['frameDigest'];frames+=len(r['frames'])
    if stage=='preflight':assert r['labelsDigest']==j['reference']['labelsDigest']and r['frameDigest']==j['reference']['lightFrameDigest']
    assert r['quality']['neural']==j['reference']['neural']and r['quality']['searchUses']==j['reference']['searchUses']
    assert[{k:v for k,v in w.items()if k!='msTotal'}for w in r['quality']['work']]==j['reference']['logicalWork']
    assert r['quality']['rejected']==0 and r['observationFault']is None and not r['pendingUncommitted']and not r['rootRecordsUncommitted']
    for n in r['quality']['neural']:
     for key in ['modelErrors','missingStart','deadlineAbstentions','inferenceOverruns']:assert n[key]==0
    for w in r['quality']['work']:
     for key in ['deadlineFallbacks','degradedDecisions','circuitSkipped','circuitWaitArbitrations']:assert w[key]==0
    assert not r['defaultChanged']and not r['modelFitted']and r['additionalRolloutsRequested']==0
    if stage=='collection':
     assert r['assignedHost']==host
     if r['familyId']in families:assert families[r['familyId']]==r['fold']
     else:families[r['familyId']]=r['fold']
    records[(stage,host,r['caseId'])]=r
  assert len(controls)==len(expected)
  for f in files:
   if '-labels.'not in f.name:continue
   for line in gzip.open(f,'rb'):
    r=json.loads(line);case_id=r['jobId'][len(stage)+1:];c=controls[case_id];assert case_id not in payloads;payloads.add(case_id)
    assert r['fold']==c['fold']and r['familyId']==c['familyId']and r['mode']=='observe'and f.name.endswith('.'+r['fold']+'.jsonl.gz')
    assert sha(line.rstrip(b'\n'))==c['labelPayloadSha256']and sha(members(line)['labels'])==c['labelsDigest']and len(r['labels'])==c['labels']
    calls={}
    for ordinal,o in enumerate(r['labels']):
     assert o['ordinal']==ordinal and 0<=o['actualTurn']<c['actualTurns']and o['rootCallOrdinal']==calls.get(o['actualTurn'],0);calls[o['actualTurn']]=o['rootCallOrdinal']+1
     units=o['publicState']['units'];assert len({u['id']for u in units})==len(units)
     actors=[u for u in units if u['id']==o['unitId']];assert len(actors)==1;a=actors[0];assert not a['dead']and a['name']==o['actor']and a['team']==o['team']
     assert o['publicState']['activeTimeDenial']==any(not u['dead']and u['turnLegality']['activeTimeDenial']for u in units)
     for u in units:
      q=u['turnLegality'];unacted=any(not v['dead']and v['team']==u['team']and v['id']!=u['id']and not v['turnLegality']['alreadyMadeTurn']for v in units)
      assert q['hasUnactedTeammate']==unacted
      assert q['canWait']==(u['team']in [1,2]and not q['hasMoved']and not o['publicState']['activeTimeDenial']and unacted and not q['isOnHourglass']and not q['hourglassIncludes']and not q['alreadyMadeTurn']and not q['alreadyHourglass'])
      for spell in u['spells']:assert spell['name']==spell['properties']['name']and isinstance(spell['remaining'],(int,float))
     for action in o['strategyActions']:
      if action['action']['type']=='wait_turn'and action['completed']:assert a['turnLegality']['canWait']
     assert bool(o['rootRecords'])==(o['rootCatalogStatus']=='searched-root')
     for root in o['rootRecords']:
      assert root['unitId']==o['unitId']and root['actualTurn']==o['actualTurn']
      for query in root['queries']:
       assert query['rollouts']>=1 and len(query['candidates'])==len(query['scores']);per={}
       for sample in query['samples']:
        assert 0<=sample['candidateIndex']<len(query['candidates'])and 0<=sample['sampleIndex']<query['rollouts']and sample['mode']==query['mode']and sample['scoreTag']!='thrown'
        index=sample['candidateIndex'];per[index]=per.get(index,0)+1;actions=query['candidates'][index]['actions'];assert len(sample['attempts'])<=len(actions)
        for index2,attempt in enumerate(sample['attempts']):assert attempt['action']['type']==actions[index2]['type']and type(attempt['completed'])is bool
       assert all(count<=query['rollouts']for count in per.values())
    observations+=len(r['labels'])
  assert payloads==set(controls)and observations==status['observations']
  if stage=='collection':total+=observations
keys=['inputSha256','traceSha256','score','winner','actualTurns','actualTurnsSha256','frameDigest','labelsDigest','labels']
for j in preflight:
 a=records[('preflight','local',j['caseId'])];b=records[('preflight','puffalo',j['caseId'])]
 for key in keys:assert a[key]==b[key],(j['caseId'],key)
if phase=='complete':
 counts={}
 for fold in families.values():counts[fold]=counts.get(fold,0)+1
 assert len(families)==1512 and counts==load('data-allocation.json')['familyFoldCounts']
 for j in cold:
  a=records[('collection',j['assignedHost'],j['caseId'])]
  for host in ['local','puffalo']:
   b=records[('cold',host,j['caseId'])]
   for key in keys:assert a[key]==b[key],(j['caseId'],host,key)
bun=load(phase+'-verification.json');assert bun['passed']and bun['registrationSha256']==seal and bun['collectionObservations']==total and bun['rawFiles']==inventory
result={'passed':True,'phase':phase,'registrationSha256':seal,'independentlyVerifiedControlRows':len(records),'independentlyVerifiedLightFrames':frames,'collectionObservations':total,
'allOriginalInputsFullTracesOutcomesTurnsLogicalCountersAndPayloadByteHashesExact':True,'allPublicLegalityMasksPassed':True,'allApplicableCrossHostPreflightAndColdControlsExact':True,
'heldoutPerformanceNotInspected':True,'newIndependentStrengthSamples':0,'modelFitted':False,'defaultChanged':False,'rawFiles':inventory}
with(p/('independent-'+phase+'-verification.json')).open('x')as f:f.write(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items()if k!='rawFiles'}))

for f in reg['files']:
 dst=p/f['path']
 if f['path'].startswith('sources/')and not dst.exists():
  src=base/f['path'];assert src.is_file()and not src.is_symlink();dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);os.link(src,dst)
 assert dst.is_file()and hashlib.sha256(dst.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==f['sha256'],f['path']

"""Transport completed records and run the frozen gates. Never start/restart a battle directly."""
from pathlib import Path,PurePosixPath
import datetime,hashlib,json,os,shlex,subprocess,tarfile,time
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
helper=Path.home()/'.codex/skills/puffalo-node-access/scripts/puffalo-status.sh'
endpoint='agent-zinc@puffalo.tailbe7bef.ts.net';key=Path.home()/'.ssh/id_ed25519_agent-zinc'
remote_root='hoc-research/barrel-catalog-teacher-v11-20261118'
regraw=(p/'registration.json').read_bytes();reg=json.loads(regraw);seal=hashlib.sha256(regraw).hexdigest()
state={'complete':False,'stage':'waiting-for-preflight','operationsPid':os.getpid(),'registrationSha256':seal,'errors':[],
       'doesNotRestartActorsOrAlterRegisteredGates':True,'fitterStarted':False,'defaultChanged':False}
def save():
 state['at']=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat();f=p/'operations-status.tmp';f.write_text(json.dumps(state,indent=2)+'\n');f.replace(p/'operations-status.json')
def sha(raw):return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
def remote(code):
 command='python3 -c '+shlex.quote(code)
 out=subprocess.check_output([str(helper),'--command',command],text=True,timeout=50)
 results=[line[len('REMOTE_RESULT='):]for line in out.splitlines()if line.startswith('REMOTE_RESULT=')]
 assert len(results)==1,out[-1800:];return json.loads(results[0])
def remote_status():
 return remote('from pathlib import Path\nimport json\np=Path('+repr(remote_root)+')\nfiles=["supervisor-puffalo.json","preflight-puffalo/status.json","collection-puffalo/status.json","cold-puffalo/status.json"]\nprint("REMOTE_RESULT="+json.dumps({n:json.loads((p/n).read_text())for n in files if(p/n).exists()}))')
def wait_stage(stage):
 deadline=reg['deadlines'][stage]
 while True:
  assert time.time()<deadline,'Registered '+stage+' cutoff reached; no extension'
  statuses=remote_status();local=p/f'{stage}-local/status.json';a=json.loads(local.read_text())if local.exists()else None;b=statuses.get(f'{stage}-puffalo/status.json')
  for s in[a,b,statuses.get('supervisor-puffalo.json')]:
   if s:assert not s['errors'],s
  for s in[a,b]:
   if s:assert s['registrationSha256']==seal
  state['stage']='waiting-for-'+stage;state['progress']={'local':{k:a.get(k)for k in ['complete','fights','expectedFights','observations','liveWorkerPids']}if a else None,
  'puffalo':{k:b.get(k)for k in ['complete','fights','expectedFights','observations','liveWorkerPids']}if b else None};save()
  if a and b and a['complete']and b['complete']:
   assert not a['liveWorkerPids']and not b['liveWorkerPids'];return
  time.sleep(20)
def transfer(stage):
 state['stage']='returning-'+stage;save()
 code='''from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,tarfile
p=Path(ROOT);stem=STAGE+"-puffalo";root=p/stem
r=json.loads((root/"status.json").read_text());assert r["complete"]and not r["errors"]and not r["liveWorkerPids"]and r["registrationSha256"]==SEAL
files=sorted(f for f in root.iterdir()if f.is_file());assert all(not f.is_symlink()for f in files)
manifest={"registrationSha256":SEAL,"stage":STAGE,"files":[{"path":str(f.relative_to(p)),"bytes":f.stat().st_size,"sha256":hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}for f in files]}
manifestfile=p/("return-"+stem+"-manifest.json");archive=p/("return-"+stem+".tar.gz")
assert not manifestfile.exists()and not archive.exists()
manifestfile.write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+"\\n")
with tarfile.open(archive,"w:gz",compresslevel=1)as t:
 for f in files+[manifestfile]:t.add(f,arcname=str(f.relative_to(p)),recursive=False)
print("REMOTE_RESULT="+json.dumps({"archive":str(archive),"bytes":archive.stat().st_size,"sha256":hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"manifestSha256":hashlib.sha256(manifestfile.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}))
'''.replace('ROOT',repr(remote_root)).replace('STAGE',repr(stage)).replace('SEAL',repr(seal))
 info=remote(code);archive=p/Path(info['archive']).name;assert not archive.exists()
 subprocess.run(['scp','-q','-P','2222','-i',str(key),endpoint+':'+info['archive'],str(archive)],check=True,timeout=180)
 assert archive.stat().st_size==info['bytes']and sha(archive.read_bytes())==info['sha256']
 with tarfile.open(archive)as t:
  members=t.getmembers();assert len({m.name for m in members})==len(members)
  for m in members:
   name=PurePosixPath(m.name);assert m.isfile()and not name.is_absolute()and '..'not in name.parts
  manifestname=f'return-{stage}-puffalo-manifest.json';manifestraw=t.extractfile(manifestname).read();assert sha(manifestraw)==info['manifestSha256']
  manifest=json.loads(manifestraw);assert manifest['registrationSha256']==seal and manifest['stage']==stage
  expected={f['path']:f for f in manifest['files']};assert {m.name for m in members}==set(expected)|{manifestname}
  # Read/verify every member before creating the completed local phase directory.
  for m in members:
   raw=t.extractfile(m).read()
   if m.name in expected:
    f=expected[m.name];assert len(raw)==f['bytes']and sha(raw)==f['sha256'];assert PurePosixPath(m.name).parts[0]==stage+'-puffalo'
  assert not(p/(stage+'-puffalo')).exists()
  for m in members:
   dest=p/m.name;dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
   with dest.open('xb')as f:f.write(t.extractfile(m).read())
 (p/f'return-{stage}-receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(info,indent=2)+'\n')
def checked(cmd,log):
 with(p/log).open('x')as f:subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=p,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
def publish(name):
 file=p/name;raw=file.read_bytes();pending=remote_root+'/'+name+'.pending'
 subprocess.run(['scp','-q','-P','2222','-i',str(key),str(file),endpoint+':'+pending],check=True,timeout=30)
 code='from pathlib import Path\nimport hashlib,json\na=Path('+repr(pending)+');b=Path('+repr(remote_root+'/'+name)+')\nassert not b.exists()\nraw=a.read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()=='+repr(sha(raw))+'\nr=json.loads(raw);assert r["registrationSha256"]=='+repr(seal)+'\na.rename(b)\nprint("REMOTE_RESULT="+json.dumps({"published":str(b),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}))'
 remote(code)
save()
try:
 wait_stage('preflight');transfer('preflight');state['stage']='independently-verifying-preflight';save()
 checked(['bun','verify.ts','preflight'],'preflight-bun-verification.log')
 checked(['python3','verify-independent.py','preflight'],'preflight-python-verification.log')
 for n in['preflight-verification.json','independent-preflight-verification.json']:
  r=json.loads((p/n).read_text());assert r['passed']and r['registrationSha256']==seal
 gate={'passed':True,'registrationSha256':seal,'bothHostPreflightFights':28,'allOriginalAndRichGoldenControlsExact':True,
 'verifiers':[{"path":n,"sha256":sha((p/n).read_bytes())}for n in['preflight-verification.json','independent-preflight-verification.json']]}
 with(p/'preflight-all-hosts.json').open('x')as f:f.write(json.dumps(gate,indent=2)+'\n')
 publish('preflight-all-hosts.json')
 wait_stage('collection');transfer('collection');state['stage']='verifying-complete-originals-for-cold';save()
 checked(['python3','build-cold-index.py'],'build-cold-index.log');publish('cold-reference-index.json');publish('collection-all-hosts.json')
 wait_stage('cold');transfer('cold');state['stage']='independently-verifying-complete-dataset';save()
 checked(['bun','verify.ts','complete'],'complete-bun-verification.log')
 checked(['python3','verify-independent.py','complete'],'complete-python-verification.log')
 for n in['complete-verification.json','independent-complete-verification.json']:
  r=json.loads((p/n).read_text());assert r['passed']and r['registrationSha256']==seal
 state['complete']=True;state['stage']='complete-verified-reused-teacher-data-no-fitter'
except BaseException as error:state['errors'].append(repr(error));state['stage']='failed-preserve-all-records-no-retry';raise
finally:save()
